text:
Maya Patel: Hey folks — quick sync. I'm requesting runtime + platform + security eyes on PR #20555 (KV-cache fallback + routing fallback). Link: https://git.redwood/pr/20555. Need: performance signoff from runtime, infra/platform for rollout/canary plan, and security for config review. Can people volunteer for owners for the canary window? :eyes:

Andre Kim: I can take runtime perf review. I'll run the perf harness tonight and post numbers. Any specific load/seq lengths to reproduce?

Maya Patel: thanks Andre. Primary workload is 4–8 token prompt prefix + 512 token gen at ~600 qps mixed — but we saw effects at 1k qps in staging. If you can run 512/1024 seq and a 90/10 mix that'd be ideal.

Sasha Li: @Kevin, @Liz can you two take platform + rollout planning? We need a canary with capacity gating and rollback hooks. I can help with canary dashboards.

Kevin Ortiz: yup can do platform rollout. propose 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 2 hours with automated evict fallback if p95 increases > 30% vs baseline. Is that acceptable to runtime?

Andre Kim: that sounds fine. I'll attach baseline p95 and a microbenchmark script. If we see KV cache miss rate spike > 15% we should auto-roll back.

Liz Chen: I'll own the canary ops. I'll need the deploy window (UTC). Happy tonight 22:00–00:00 UTC if that works for infra.

Maya Patel: 22:00 UTC SGTM. Liz please create the canary runbook in the PR comments with rollback steps. @security-bot any blockers on config flags or new ACLs?

security-bot: quick config check: PR touches routing rules + a new env var REDWOOD_ALLOW_KV_FALLBACK. We need a short threat note and to ensure KMS usage unchanged. No blocking issues but please add a one-paragraph justification and confirm the env var is not set in prod prior to canary. :lock:

Maya Patel: noted — I'll add the threat note and confirm env var absent in prod. Infra-bot, can you post CI status?

infra-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e). Staging perf suite queued; ETA ~40m.

Kevin Ortiz: will schedule the canary and add the rollout policy to the PR. tagging @Sasha for dashboard links.

Sasha Li: added the dashboard links and a small alert runbook. @Andre please drop perf numbers when done and we can merge after security note and runbook are attached. :thumbsup:

Andre Kim: perf run done — p95 +5ms at 600qps, +18ms at 1kqps with fallback enabled. attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx. Looks acceptable for canary at 1% but keep eye on 10%.

Maya Patel: perfect. I'll add the threat note and runbook now. Thanks everyone — will proceed with canary at 22:00 UTC if no further objections. :rocket:
